connections.title: QuickBooks Online MCP tool names (get_customer, create_invoice, search_invoices, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to QBO_MCP_URL with QBO_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Nineteen tool names of the open-source QuickBooks Online MCP server are exposed as aliases and return JSON objects. That server is a stdio process that calls Intuit itself, so point the agent at this endpoint instead of launching it.

connections.title: QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 over HTTP
connections.instructions: Point your QuickBooks client's base URL at QBO_BASE_URL (instead of https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com) and send QBO_ACCESS_TOKEN as the OAuth 2 Bearer token. Paths are /v3/company/9341453172839201/<entity>. Both variable names are a test-side convention: Intuit SDKs hard-code the host, so the client must be configured to read the base URL.
